Does PCOS change
at menopause?
Researchers are looking at how male
hormone levels change as women
with PCOS grow older. They think that
as women reach menopause, ovarian
function changes and the menstrual
cycle may become more normal. But
even with falling male hormone levels,
excessive hair growth continues, and
male pattern baldness or thinning hair
gets worse after menopause.
